title: Convergence of integrals under uniform convergence on a compact set containing the supports
statement: Let n be a natural number; integrals are Bochner integrals for Lebesgue measure on R^n. Let K be a compact subset of R^n, f_k : R^n -> R (k in N) and g : R^n -> R. Assume: f_k is integrable for all sufficiently large k; g is integrable; for all sufficiently large k, f_k(z) = 0 for every z not in K; g(z) = 0 for every z not in K; and f_k -> g uniformly on K as k -> infinity. Then the integral of f_k over R^n tends to the integral of g over R^n as k -> infinity.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (K : Set (Rn n)) (f : ℕ → Rn n → ℝ) (g : Rn n → ℝ), IsCompact K → (∀ᶠ k in atTop, Integrable (f k)) → Integrable g → (∀ᶠ k in atTop, ∀ z, z ∉ K → f k z = 0) → (∀ z, z ∉ K → g z = 0) → TendstoUniformlyOn f g atTop K → Tendsto (fun k => ∫ z, f k z) atTop (𝓝 (∫ z, g z))
